info.title: Capability Explorer central collection intake
info.description: Design-only boundary for offline ce.collection.v1 bundle submission and receipt lookup. No provider, deployment, transport authorization, or anonymous access is implemented or approved.

x-deployment-blockers: Central intake owner and operational support are unassigned.
Transport authentication, authorization, tenant scope enforcement, rate limits, and retention policy are unresolved.
A missing OpenAPI security requirement is not approval for anonymous exposure.
x-receipt-semantics: Each submission attempt remains auditable. Identical validated content may reuse stored content, but retries do not promise one permanent receipt ID. received and validated are not published; published requires platform publication metadata.

post.description: Proposed multipart transfer. The manifest declares exact artifact paths, lengths, and hashes; each artifact file part name must match a manifest artifactPath. Receivers must verify actual bytes and enforce tenant/rights authorization. No URI retrieval is permitted.

202.description: Attempt recorded as received. This response does not imply validation or publication.

409.description: Attempt identity or repository revision conflicts with an existing immutable record.

413.description: Transfer exceeds an enforced receiver limit.

422.description: Manifest, bytes, identity, or required profile failed validation.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of one submission attempt
get.description: A receipt lookup returns attempt state only. It does not expose a third-party artifact download endpoint or imply that a validated bundle has been published.

404.description: Attempt is not visible in the caller's authorized scope.

artifacts.description: Raw file parts are bounded by the manifest and receiver policy. File names carry the literal artifactPath; they are not URI references.

TwoRepositorySubmission.description: Artifact array entries are byte-part placeholders for documentation; they are not process data or credentials.
